## Activity

During February 2022, East City Eye Clinic completed 120 captures. This provides the activity total for the month and records the volume of images submitted through the clinic’s eye screening service. The activity was recorded for routine operational monitoring and supports review of the service’s performance during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for assessment. The ungradable rate was 0.8, with 1 capture recorded as ungradable. This result should be considered alongside the total activity for February 2022 when reviewing image acquisition and any requirements for repeat photography. The available information identifies the number of ungradable captures and the corresponding rate for the month.

## Grading

Grading identified 23 referable results. The median lag from capture to grading was 15 days. These measures provide a summary of the grading outcome and the time taken for images to progress through the assessment process. Together, they support routine oversight of referral levels and grading timeliness at East City Eye Clinic during February 2022.
